heading: Surveys of Coast Guard families

tree.heading: Authority.—
tree.text: The Commandant, in order to determine the effectiveness of Federal policies, programs, and activities related to the families of Coast Guard members, may survey—

children.text: the immediate family of any Coast Guard member or retired Coast Guard member; and
any survivor of a deceased Coast Guard member.

tree.heading: Voluntary Participation.—
tree.text: Participation in any survey conducted under subsection (a) shall be voluntary.

tree.heading: Federal Recordkeeping.—
tree.text: Each individual surveyed under subsection (a) shall be considered an employee of the United States for purposes of section 3502(3)(A)(i) of title 44.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 2902 was renumbered section 5102 of this title.
Amendments2021—Subsec. (c). Pub. L. 116–283 substituted “individual” for “person”. 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 532 of this title as this section.
